US History.title: United States Constitution
US History.author: 13 Signers
US History.description: 'The United States Constitution' by United States is a foundational document drafted in 1787 and operational since 1789. Born from the failures of the Articles of Confederation, it establishes the supreme law of America through seven original articles defining federal government structure.

US History.title: The Declaration of Independence
US History.author: Thomas Jefferson
US History.description: The historic document adopted by the Second Continental Congress meeting at the Pennsylvania State House in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on July 4, 1776. It announced that the thirteen American colonies, then at war with Great Britain, regarded themselves as independent.

US History.title: The Bill of Rights
US History.author: James Madison
US History.description: The first ten amendments to the United States Constitution. Written to address the objections raised by Anti-Federalists, these amendments guarantee essential rights and civil liberties.

US History.title: The Federalist Papers
US History.author: Hamilton, Madison, & Jay
US History.description: A collection of 85 articles and essays written by Alexander Hamilton, James Madison, and John Jay under the collective pseudonym 'Publius' to promote the ratification of the United States Constitution.

World History.title: The Art of War
World History.author: Sun Tzu
World History.description: An ancient Chinese military treatise dating from the Late Spring and Autumn Period. The work is composed of 13 chapters, detailing military strategy.

World History.title: Meditations
World History.author: Marcus Aurelius
World History.description: A series of personal writings by Marcus Aurelius, Roman Emperor, recording his private notes to himself and ideas on Stoic philosophy.

WW1.title: The Economic Consequences of the Peace
WW1.author: John Maynard Keynes
WW1.description: Keynes' famous critique of the Treaty of Versailles following World War I, analyzing its devastating economic impact on Europe.

WW2.title: Strategy & Strategy Guidelines: Allied Operations
WW2.author: US Dept of War
WW2.description: An archival collection of strategy reports, command decisions, and historical reviews regarding Allied military operations in Europe and the Pacific during World War II.
WW2.disclaimer-text: Provided under educational fair-use research parameters.

Math.title: Euclid's Elements
Math.author: Euclid
Math.description: The classic treatise on geometry. For over two millennia, this was the primary textbook for teaching mathematics.

Math.title: Relativity: The Special and General Theory
Math.author: Albert Einstein
Math.description: Einstein's own explanation of his famous theory, written for the general public.

ELA.title: The Elements of Style
ELA.author: William Strunk Jr.
ELA.description: The classic American English writing style guide, offering practical advice on grammar, composition, and spelling rules.

ELA.title: Merriam-Webster's Dictionary
ELA.author: Noah Webster
ELA.description: The classic American dictionary containing comprehensive vocabulary references, etymologies, and definitions.
